seoTitle: Fix Disappearing Messages (Vanish Mode) on Instagram
metaDescription: Fix issues with Instagram's Disappearing Messages, formerly Vanish Mode, by updating the app, checking region availability, and clearing cache.
intro: Instagram renamed Vanish Mode to Disappearing Messages, and some users run into trouble activating or using it after the change. This guide explains the rename, how to turn the feature on, and what to try if it's still not working.

steps.heading: Understand the rename
steps.body: Vanish Mode is now called Disappearing Messages inside Instagram chats, with the same core functionality — messages disappear after being seen and you exit the chat.

steps.heading: Update the Instagram app
steps.body: Check the App Store or Google Play Store for an update, since most feature bugs are fixed in newer versions.

steps.heading: Check regional availability
steps.body: Instagram rolls out features gradually, so confirm Disappearing Messages is supported in your region.

steps.heading: Activate it in a chat
steps.body: Open the chat you want to use it in, then swipe up from the bottom of the screen until the screen darkens or a Disappearing Mode prompt appears.

steps.heading: Clear cache or reinstall if needed
steps.body: On Android, clear the Instagram cache under Settings > Apps > Instagram > Storage. If that doesn't help, uninstall and reinstall the app to reset any corrupted settings.

faq.question: What happened to Vanish Mode on Instagram?
faq.answer: It was renamed to Disappearing Messages, but the core feature works the same way — messages disappear after you view them and leave the chat.

faq.question: Why can't I activate Disappearing Messages?
faq.answer: This can happen if the app isn't updated, the feature isn't yet available in your region, or there's a cache-related glitch.

faq.question: Does account type affect this feature?
faq.answer: Yes, some professional accounts may behave differently, so using a Creator or Personal account can matter.

faq.question: Will reinstalling Instagram delete my messages?
faq.answer: Reinstalling resets local app data and settings but doesn't delete your account or message history stored on Instagram's servers.
